derived_interpretation: The source/target-only review setting did not reliably surface a small local hard-line-break defect inside a long target; every scored route instead marked R033 as semantically complete.

Most false positives required runtime context or project terminology to refute. This is direct evidence that source/target-only review has a low ceiling for context-dependent judgments in this sample.
The lower false-positive count of the Gemini reference route does not constitute better defect detection because it also missed the only confirmed atom.
The result is evidence about this frozen 40-item set and this one positive atom, not a general ordering of the models.
human_recommendations_not_measured_resul: Use deterministic lint for hard line feeds inside Chinese words and for suspicious extra paragraph breaks; this defect class should not rely only on an LLM reviewer.
For the next independent experiment, compare source/target-only review with review that also receives fixed source-code/runtime and terminology evidence.
Stratify future results into visible formatting defects, runtime-context defects and terminology-contract defects, and collect more than one positive atom before comparing models.
